justification.dataset: Allen Visual Coding Neuropixels (000021) with drifting/static gratings in VISp and higher visual areas is the canonical dataset for orientation selectivity.
justification.handling: Real data streamed via LINDI across three sessions with explicit good-quality unit filtering and structure mapping through the electrodes table, and correct per-sweep rate computation.
justification.analysis: Vector-based gOSI/gDSI are the correct circular statistics, backed by a proper direction-label shuffle permutation null and an independent static-grating replication.
justification.correctness: Every headline number reproduces exactly from the committed metrics CSV, is internally consistent with the figures, and rests on adequate sample sizes and permutation-based significance.
justification.figures: Figures clearly show the effect with labeled axes, units, and sample sizes, and example units span the full selectivity range including honestly-shown flat units.
justification.honesty: Claims are proportionate to a genuinely clean, well-supported result and nothing is misrepresented, but the write-up names no specific limitations (single stimulus paradigm, passive viewing, three sessions).
